concerns.location: tasks.md:T006 vs constitution.md:Principle VII and spec.md:SC-001/FR-007
concerns.text: Constitution VII states manual verification of 50 PRs per group with Cohen's κ 'MUST be performed', and FR-007/SC-001 require a calculated κ. T006 permits the pipeline to complete (T010 full run, paper handoff) with κ permanently 'pending' and SC-001 'unverified' — no task owns producing `data/processed/manual_labels.csv`. This is a silent relaxation of a MUST into an optional step; either add an explicit human-labeling task/owner or have the spec/constitution document the staging.

FR-004 requires the system to 'automatically detect data-distribution normality and select the appropriate statistical test'. T004 pre-specifies Mann-Whitney U as primary with the Welch t-test as companion 'regardless of normality outcome', so automatic test selection is effectively disabled. The plan documents this deviation, but the tasks document should state explicitly that FR-004's automatic-selection clause is superseded by the pre-specified design (or the spec should be amended) so the deviation is not silent.

FR-012 requires issue severity 'as a quantitative metric for comparison between groups'. T004 compares severity only via chi-square/Cramér's V (categorical), matching the schema enum but not the spec's 'quantitative metric' wording. Either add an ordinal/quantitative severity comparison or reconcile FR-012's wording with the categorical treatment.
